hook: I lost $20K trading 0DTE options in my first year.
pain_point: Struggling traders who feel isolated and have experienced losses.
target_icp: Beginner to intermediate traders looking for community support and guidance.
promise: Gain consistent trading skills by learning live with an experienced trader.
mechanism: Live trading sessions that provide real-time insights and strategies.
visual_pattern: Text-based with a focus on personal storytelling and community engagement.
marketing_angle: Transforming past failures into a learning opportunity within a supportive community.
why_it_works: It leverages personal experience to build trust and encourages participation through a risk-free trial.

hook: See tomorrow's 7:30 AM call live

hook: We post our red days too.

visual_pattern: Image-based advertisement with a focus on authenticity.

why_it_works: By showcasing both successes and failures, it builds trust and sets realistic expectations for potential traders.
